description: This C# source file implements the AzureBasedMembershipTable class, which is a partial implementation of the IMembershipTable interface in Orleans. It manages membership data for silos in a cluster using Azure Table Storage, including initialization, reading, inserting, updating, and cleaning up membership entries. The class contains methods for converting between storage entities and in-memory representations, as well as detailed logging for various operations and errors.

classes.name: AzureBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: An internal class implementing membership table functionalities using Azure Table Storage for Orleans silos.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, attempts to create a version row if needed.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a given clusterId.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silo entries older than a specified date.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads the membership data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Retrieves all silo entries from the table.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry with a table version, handling contention.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry conditionally, based on etag.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a membership entry.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a list of Azure table entries into MembershipTableData.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a SiloInstanceTableEntry into a MembershipEntry.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a MembershipEntry into a SiloInstanceTableEntry for storage.

methods.name: ConvertPartial
methods.description: Creates a minimal SiloInstanceTableEntry for partial updates.
